source_of_truth: The submission form in the CrazyGames developer portal states the current limits next to every field. The numbers below come from the portal's own game-covers documentation; when the form disagrees, the form wins and this file is updated in the same commit.
confirmed_by_docs: all three covers are mandatory and must share one visual style
covers carry no border, no text other than the title, and no store or social icons
a cover is not a screenshot of the game
the preview video is required in landscape AND portrait, 1080p, 15-20 seconds, no audio, at most 50 MB
the preview video opens on the static cover frame and contains no black screens, letterbox bars, cursor or promotional text
the game itself must ship English
the initial download stays under 50 MB, and under 20 MB to pass the Basic Launch benchmark
load time to first interaction stays under 10 seconds
